summary.en: A matrix of steps by targets: an accent cursor walks the cells, each finished cell is marked DONE and its column gets an accent underline; a 400 px side numeral counts columns and a strip sums the run.
summary.zh: “步骤 × 对象”的矩阵：强调色光标逐格走过，完成的格子标上“完成”，整列完成后划一道强调色下划线；侧边 400 px 数字计列，底部一条汇总。

fits: A chapter page where the same steps run over several targets: databases, regions, services, files.
notFor: More than 4 × 5 cells; steps that run in parallel (the cursor is one at a time).

intent.en: Show a run as progress through a grid: one cursor, one cell at a time, so order and completeness read at once.
intent.zh: 把一次运行画成在格子里推进：一个光标、一次一格，顺序和完成度一眼可读。

content.en: Page head, 2–4 row names, 2–5 column names (≤ 10 chars), a done label, a side number and a strip line.
content.zh: 页头、2–4 个行名、2–5 个列名（≤ 5 字）、“完成”标签、侧边数字和一行汇总。

fits.zh: 某章里同一组步骤跑过多个对象：数据库、地区、服务、文件。

notFor.zh: 超过 4 × 5 格；并行执行的步骤（光标一次只在一格）。

en: The DONE label is a mono label: in Chinese it is 完成 at 28 px, not capitals.
zh: “完成”是等宽标签：中文 28 px，不转大写。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
